# Beyond Nakasendo Cycling

> Guided e-bike tours, self-guided e-bike rentals and a luggage shuttle through the hidden side of the Kiso Valley in Nagiso, Nagano, Japan — near the Nakasendo post towns of Tsumago and Magome. Local guides take you to emerald gorges, old forest-railway paths, river swimming holes, and an onsen, away from the day-tripper crowds. Operated by Kashiwaya Guesthouse (From Scratch LLC).

## Key facts
- Base: Nagiso, Kiso Valley, Nagano, Japan (near Tsumago & Magome on the Nakasendo)
- Bikes: MOVE fat-tire e-bikes; helmet, lock, and lights included
- Rental bikes are delivered to the spot you choose anywhere in the Tsumago–Nojiri area (your inn, a station, a trailhead) and can be dropped off at any spot in the area when you finish
- Up to 4 rental bikes per day; one of them fits children
- Closed every Monday (all services except accommodation)
- Payment: no prepayment — on the day, a Square card payment link is sent on WhatsApp (cash at the counter also welcome)
- Contact: phone/text +81 90-3839-2354, email ravnicaguild@gmail.com

## Routes (self-guided)
- Tsumago, Revisited — easy; best in spring & autumn; a quiet local road into Tsumago post town
- Natural AC & Onsen — moderate; best in summer (river swim) & early winter (onsen); rice-paddy roads and two waterfalls
- Nakasendo Challenge — hard; the Yogawa trail crossing, for confident riders only

## Pricing
- E-bike rental (self-guided): ¥4,000 per bike, up to 4 bikes; route maps free
- Guided full-day Kiso River Downhill: regular ¥80,000 for a group of up to 4 riders (±¥12,000 per rider more or fewer); opening campaign: half price (e.g. ¥40,000 for 4 riders)
- Luggage shuttle along the valley: priced per route — see https://nakasendo-ebike.com/luggage-shuttle
